facts.fact: The Ethiopian Statistics Service signed a memorandum of understanding with 12 federal institutions, including Justice, Foreign Affairs, the Police Commission and eight others, to organise their administrative migration data to a quality usable for official statistics, with a migration database to be built at the Service.
facts.system: Migration data management and exchange MoU
